an1.198:1.1: He was slow of understanding, rejected even by his brother, but then, supported by the Buddha, he achieved mastery ([thag10.4]()). The younger brother of Mahāpanthaka, he is praised at [ud5.10](), and give effective instruction to the nuns at [pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.1]().
an1.199:1.1: The “evolution of heart” (_cetovivaṭṭa_) and the “evolution of perception” (_saññāvivaṭṭa_) are obscure terms found only here. Perhaps “evolution of heart” refers to Cūḷapanthaka’s remarkable transformation.
an1.200:1.1: His verses are at [thag8.3](), where tells of undertaking the resolve to not sit down until awakened.
